text:
maria.release: Quick sync 1: finalizing internal RN for tomorrow's rollout. Changes: autoscaler backoff tweak, default batching tweak for short sequences, and defensive pin for model-family-A to v1.4.2. Need ops steps, deploybot command, and short staff blurb.

dan.sre: Canary windows ok. Recommend staging 15m, prod canary 30m. Rollback triggers: error rate +4% sustained 5m OR P95 latency +30% for 10m. Add health-check commands.

paul.docs: Draft TL;DR: "Stability & performance: autoscaler/backoff tuning, improved batching for short requests, and model-family-A fallback pinned to v1.4.2. Short canary then staged rollout." I'll format RN (TL;DR / What changed / Ops).

ops-oncall: Put explicit commands in RN. Evac runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-evac. Contact list: dan.sre, ops-oncall, maria.release.

maria.release: Proposed deploybot command: `/deploy schedule release-2026-04-02 --canary staging:2026-04-02T01:00Z,prod:2026-04-02T02:00Z --notify eng-oncall,eng-sre --notes "autoscaler+batching+model-pin"`

Deploy Bot: Scheduled release-2026-04-02 (staging canary 2026-04-02T01:00Z, prod canary 2026-04-02T02:00Z). Ping targets: eng-oncall, eng-sre. Status: queued.

dan.sre: Health checks: `curl -fsS https://staging.health/ping` and `kubectl get pods -l release=release-2026-04-02 -n runtime`. If aborted: scale down new RS and run `/deploy rollback release-2026-04-02`.

paul.docs: I'll add YAML snippet for model pin: `model_pin:
  model-family-A: v1.4.2
  fallback_window: 5m` and prepare the staff email at T-30m.

maria.release: Thanks. Drop RN link here when ready and we'll set the deploybot announce. Standby staging canary 01:00 UTC.
